contract.feature: Preserve live navigation mission across measured stopped relocalization
contract.scope: Directed fixed authored planar road graph; supplied map and synchronous body XY scans. Other mapped controls/lane changes remain excluded.
contract.ownership: Preserve original destination, active route, accepted revision, closures, route-switch count and mapped speeds. Re-evaluate pending plan from the new measured pose.
contract.stop: Clear all route-handover votes and advance motion watermark to reset; require three subsequent fresh healthy stopped acquisitions.
contract.admission: Measured pose must lie inside the active corridor with configured body/margin and heading bound; failed admission stays latched until measured initialization.
contract.fault: An existing navigation fault cannot be cleared by localization reset; later ordinary valid newer external snapshots retain their admission rules.
contract.evaluation: Freeze all input routes/maps/schedules/gates before first physical run. Independent path enumeration, speed/closure/collision scoring, covariance and exact sensor replay.
contract.maturity: Prior subjective estimate 28%; 30% automotive waypoint remains unmet. Assess scope after evidence.
